description: Unset an environment variable. Optional scope picks which stored value to remove: 'all' (default), or 'live'/'preview' to drop just that deploy type's override.

scope.description: Which scoped value to remove: 'all' (default), 'live', or 'preview'. Use 'preview' to drop a preview-only override without touching the value live deploys see.

name: percher_env_unset
